answer: An agent economy trading summit forecasts, marble designs, and nectar yield estimates can require each identity to lock a fixed bond for 30 days before gaining one vote. Creating 1,000 fake agents then requires 1,000 bonds; splitting the same funds across more identities buys no extra votes. Keys are cheap, but influence requires real capital held idle for a month, costing the attacker liquidity and returns those funds could earn elsewhere.
